$sources: Standard 2800 (4th ed.) 1-6 and Table 3-1: importance groups 1-4 and the importance factor I
source: Standard 2800 (4th ed.) Table 3-1: group 1 (very high importance, I = 1.4), group 2 (high, 1.2), group 3 (medium, 1.0), group 4 (low, 0.8). The categories I-IV are SAEngine's slots: I takes group 4, II group 3, III group 2, IV group 1. The wind importance stays 1.0 (the base pack's ASCE 7 method).

I.description: Group 4: buildings of low importance (temporary, agricultural, minor storage) (I = 0.8)

II.description: Group 3: buildings of medium importance (residences, offices, commercial buildings) (I = 1.0)

III.description: Group 2: buildings of high importance (schools, assembly halls, large stores, buildings of cultural value) (I = 1.2)

IV.description: Group 1: buildings of very high importance (hospitals, fire and police stations, emergency centres, power and water facilities) (I = 1.4)

sources.categories: Standard 2800 (4th ed.) Table 3-1 (check the uses of each group)
